basis: The dashboard plots 'Year vs. Price in U.S. dollars per barrel'. The y-axis is inverted, with values increasing downwards from 0 to 35. The task requires routing the year with the 'highest per-barrel cost'. On this chart, the highest cost corresponds to the lowest point on the visual graph (the maximum y-value). The data point for the year 1980 is at the bottom of the chart, approximately at a value of 38, which is the maximum value observed in the series. Other candidate years like 1976 are near the top (low cost) and 1986 is in the mid-range.
